source: sw1 (b777): Noah 10/20 "the Nike swoosh needs to be centered on the sleeve, not blocking or getting blocked by anything" (finding 5, the Colts first); placements measured on the hi_body model against every 2026 kit's sleeve and torso art, its arm-number route and number glyphs
method: One rule for every 2026 kit: on kits whose arm number sits on the sleeve (Unif route 3/4, route 0 = sleeve_A) the swoosh is centred over the two-digit number just above it; on the others it keeps the shared place under the shoulder number; either way the nearest place (smallest turn around the arm) where the mark, grown 0.3 cm, lies on one plain field, clear of every digit 0-9, with no holes. The old mark is painted out (re-authored art under it where the team spec still matches the disc, else its texture row), and the swoosh is laid down by "warp" from the Packers home sleeve's own swoosh (10H0 chunk 3, white on green, unchanged by this layer) through a mesh measured on the model, in each UV patch the mark covers. Exceptions where the 2026 jersey differs: Bengals under the tiger stripes, Broncos on the mountain panel (uf3), Texans red alternate on the horn (Noah), all kept.
